description: The standard concepts that need vocabulary of their own (docs/foundation.md, Part II). Derived terms such as core Language, pure, shared and abstract are formulas, not Entities. Extends Kernel, Contexts and Operations.

axioms.about: An Action's primary Parameter is one of its own
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.primary. p in i.parameters

axioms.about: A comparison is an Interaction over its Entity's Language
axioms.formula: all e in Entity, c in e.comparison. e.language in c.language.*extends

axioms.about: A deferral names exactly one item
axioms.formula: all d in Deferred. (some d.entity and no d.relationship) or (some d.relationship and no d.entity)

axioms.about: A deferred Entity is in the source Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all d in Deferred, x in d.entity. x.language in d.transformation.source.*extends

axioms.about: A deferred Relationship is in the source Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all d in Deferred, x in d.relationship. x.language in d.transformation.source.*extends
